page.layout: One page of running text in a single column, with a decorated initial opening the chapter. No marginal notes. Printed page number at the top right corner. Catchword at the lower right and gathering signature at the foot centre.

main_text.head: IV. DE REPUBLICA ARGIVORUM.
main_text.p: QUEMADMODUM antiquitate, ita potentia & claritudine inter Græcos Argivi olim præstitère, quorum metropolis Argos in regione Peloponnesi, quam ex ea Argolicam nuncuparunt, pluribus urbibus quondam inclyta: inter quas celeberrima Troicis temporibus Mycenæ, regia Agamemnonis, à Perseo Danaës filio, Acrisii nepote condita: deinde Epidaurus, Trœzen, Phlius, Corinthus, Sicyon. Argiva civitas à temporibus Inachi primi conditoris regio imperio paruit. In quo cum esset Tisamenus Orestis filius, Agamemnonis nepos, Heraclidis in Peloponnesum revertentibus regno ab iis eje&us[?] succes-forem accepit Temenum Heraclidarum fratrum natu maximum, ex quo Macedonum reges ortum trahere feruntur. Hic à filiis propterea, quod genero Diophonti plus quàm ipsis studere videretur, interemptus Cisum primogenitum regni hæredem reliquit. At fuit regum horum moderata potestas: Argivi enim, ut ait Pausanias, ab antiquissimis

page.notes: Decorated woodcut initial Q, joined to the first word. Page number read as "81"; the final digit is doubtful. The word "eje&us" (ejectus, with the ct ligature) is uncertain. "succes-forem" is printed with a hyphen at the line end. The catchword "tem" and the signature "f" are at the foot. The right edge shows the neighbouring page and show-through, which are not transcribed.
